name: Mars InSight Cruise Stage
about: Mars InSight Cruise Stage (2018-042A, NASA/JPL), launched 2018 May  5. Its phases from GCAT: HCO, Mars. Orbits keep GCAT's shape and inclination; their orientation and the place along them are estimated.

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; carried by another craft, whose orbit this is
the arc is solved from its ends (leaving Earth, meeting Mars on GCAT's date); its perihelion 1.007 au and aphelion 1.433 au against GCAT's 1.008 and 1.434
